items.prompt: A desert at night: a huge wooden sculpture burns in the middle of a flat dry plain, sparks rising into a vast starry sky, a ring of thousands of people standing in silhouette around the fire at a distance.

alt.ru: Ночная пустыня: посреди равнины горит огромная деревянная скульптура, искры летят в звёздное небо, вокруг огня кольцом стоят тысячи силуэтов.
alt.en: A desert at night: a huge wooden sculpture burns on a flat plain, sparks rising into a starry sky, thousands of silhouettes ringed around the fire.
alt.pt: Um deserto à noite: uma enorme escultura de madeira arde numa planície, faíscas a subir para o céu estrelado, milhares de silhuetas em círculo à volta do fogo.
alt.es: Un desierto de noche: una enorme escultura de madera arde en una llanura, chispas subiendo al cielo estrellado, miles de siluetas en círculo alrededor del fuego.
